notes.title: From the Creators of Sandbox Skyline... INFEST is out today!
notes.content:
Dear Pixel-Lovers,

If you enjoyed the creativity and strategic planning of Sandbox Skyline, you’ll love INFEST 1.0 for its deep tactical gameplay and endless possibilities. While Sandbox Skyline lets you shape the world, INFEST challenges you to survive and thrive in one that’s already out to get you.

[previewyoutube=SwAHEu8xwdg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Why Sandbox Skyline Fans Should Try INFEST:[/b]

	•	Creative Problem-Solving: Just like designing the perfect city, building the right deck in INFEST requires foresight, experimentation, and strategy.

	•	System-Driven Gameplay: INFEST’s dynamic environments (fire, oil, water, and more) offer complex interactions for you to exploit—similar to the systems in Sandbox Skyline.

	•	Replayability: Whether it’s a sprawling city or a procedurally generated alien battlefield, INFEST keeps you coming back for more.

INFEST has been in development for over 2 years and leaves Early Access today, don't miss the launch discount before it expires :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2341560/Infest/

notes.title: Sandbox Skyline V1.1 Major Update!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone!

It’s been just over a month since we released V1.0 of Sandbox Skyline and we are happy to have gotten lots of feedback since then.

Version 1.1 contains a lot of these suggestions, mainly quality of life fixes and adjustments to levels. For the patch we are also offering the game at 20% off :)

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/extras/g1.gif?t=1704901530[/img]

Thanks for your support and feedback we are happy to have Sandbox Skyline out in the world and looking forward to seeing how it develops in the upcoming months.

-Sandbox Skyline Team

notes.title: Sandbox Skyline V1.0 is available now!
notes.content:
After many years of development, Sandbox Skyline V1.0 is available now! It's also on sale with a 20% launch discount.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/extras/g1.gif?t=1704901530[/img]

We are excited to hear what you think about the game, let us know in the community forum. 

Many thanks for your support over the years, we're a small studio and could not do it without you! We'll be pushing additional content updates over the next few months so stay tuned :)

-Sandbox Skyline Team

notes.title: Sandbox Skyline, V1.0 launching January 10th!
notes.content:
The title says it all! After several years of hard work, Sandbox Skyline is ready for release January 10th. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/extras/g1.gif?t=1696440057[/img]

We'll also be offering a launch discount for our early adopters :) 

Thanks again for your support during this journey, we are excited to get Sandbox Skyline out into the world.

notes.title: Sandbox Skyline V0.3 and Steam Next Fest October
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We've been very busy working on the full version of Sandbox Skyline as our release date approaches. We've been building the full level set and making adjustments to the current demo levels. You will see this reflected in the recently published V0.3.0 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/extras/g2.gif?t=1686059661[/img]

We will also be participating in Steam Next Fest October! We'll be available any time during the festival to chat about the game on our [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]discord.[/url]

Thanks for all your feedback so far, we are excited to get Sandbox Skyline out to the world soon :)

notes.title: August Update
notes.content:
The demo is now LIVE and we've been getting a lot of great feedback from you! We are very busy working on improvements and making content for the full version of the game. Stay tuned we'll be pushing updates to the demo here soon :)

-Carl

notes.title: Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
The first public version of Sandbox Skyline is here!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/extras/g1.gif?t=1686059674[/img]

The demo will be evolving over the next several months with your feedback. Drop me a line on [url=http://www.chuteapps.com/discord]Discord[/url] or on the community page, I am very much open to suggestions :)

-Carl

notes.title: April Progress Update
notes.content:
What's new with Sandbox Skyline???

Quite a lot. We're in the thick of getting the first playable version ready: working on items, levels, and nature events. 

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2307840/ss_d84e93400fdb8e48b69b6be02b5b2cdc4fb1bcbb.1920x1080.jpg?t=1678139164[/img]

When can we expect the demo to be ready?

Still a bit early to say but I'm hoping in the next few months. For first access you can sign up for the private beta at:

http://chuteapps.com/sandbox-skyline-beta/

More to come... stay tuned.

-Carl

notes.title: Upcoming Private Beta
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

I'll be launching a private beta for Sandbox Skyline in the upcoming months. This will be the very first look at the game and give me a chance to collect feedback for modifications and tweaks.

Beta access is free and time limited, Sign Up here: 

[b]http://chuteapps.com/sandbox-skyline-beta/[/b]

-Carl

notes.title: Sandbox Skyline officially Announced!
notes.content:
After many months of hard work, I am pleased to announce:

Sandbox Skyline!

The game where you make skyscrapers out of magical falling sand.

This is the very beginning of our journey and we will be posting updates regularly. I am very excited to see how this game will develop over the upcoming months.

-Carl
